text:
oncall-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: hosted-api / generate (streaming) — p99 latency breach > SLO (2.5s). Auto-paging to #incidents. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/stream-latency. Thread: 2234567000
oncall-bot: metrics snapshot: p95=1.18s p99=3.62s error-rate=0.2% streaming-stalls=+420% (10m)
alex (eng-oncall): I'm taking this. seeing the p99 spike on generate-stream around 15:12 UTC. Any deploys or config flips? @casey can you confirm what rolled?
casey (eng-runtime): we started a controlled ramp of the new quant profile "int8-ramp-v2" ~10m ago to 30% of traffic. telemetry shows tail regressions for requests with context > 1024 tokens. KV cache churn looks higher. grabbing logs now.
casey (eng-runtime): quick queries:
```
redwoodctl metrics query --service=hosted-api --metric=p99_latency --range=15m
redwoodctl model traffic --model=generator-v3 --profile=int8-ramp-v2
```
casey (eng-runtime): sample log (streaming worker 7):
```
[15:14:22] dequantize: 0.78s
[15:14:22] kv-lookup: hit=false key=ctx:session:abc123
[15:14:23] stream-send: timeout=3s
```
casey (eng-runtime): looks like dequant + cache misses are adding non-trivial tail time; small requests unaffected. pattern = long-context streaming stalls.
alex (eng-oncall): ok. rolling mitigation options: A) rollback int8-ramp-v2 to previous int8-v1 B) route streaming traffic >1k tokens to fp16-fallback C) increase stream timeouts temporarily + enable aggressive prefix caching. Thoughts? @sophia
sophia (eng-sre): I'm taking the page. Recommend B then A if B insufficient — routing is lower-risk and faster. I'll start a targeted traffic rule: redirect generator-v3 streaming calls with estimated tokens>=1024 to fp16-fallback. Applying now.
sophia (eng-sre): running rule: `trafficctl add-rule --svc hosted-api --match "stream && est_tokens>=1024" --target fp16-fallback --priority 10`
oncall-bot: action performed: traffic rule applied by sophia at 15:18:04 UTC. Estimated affected sessions: ~5% of global traffic but accounts for ~40% of p99 contribution.
jordan (prod): monitoring dashboards — p99 dropped from 3.6s -> 2.1s within two mins after rule. p95 stable. streaming stall rate down ~60%.
alex (eng-oncall): nice. leaving routing in place for now. let's also pause the int8-ramp-v2 rollout to prevent further churn. @casey can you pause the ramp?
casey (eng-runtime): pausing now: `modelsctl rollout pause --model generator-v3 --profile int8-ramp-v2`
oncall-bot: rollout paused by casey at 15:20:31 UTC.
mike (cs): heads-up — I have an incoming ticket from AcmeCo reporting intermittent slow responses in their chatflows at ~15:13 UTC. I told them we're investigating and applied mitigations; they want ETA and whether there's data loss. Any update I can share?
alex (eng-oncall): share that we've applied a routing mitigation to divert long streaming requests to fp16 fallback, p99 improved, no data loss observed. ETA: monitoring for 15m to confirm stability, then we'll start rollback of the profile if stable. Assign a follow-up with CS.
mike (cs): will update AcmeCo and flag their account for priority watch. thanks. :thumbsup:
casey (eng-runtime): additional note: memory pressure on streaming workers was modestly higher with int8-ramp-v2 for long contexts — might be an interaction between dequant path and KV cache evictions. we'll capture heap/pmem dumps for postmortem.
sophia (eng-sre): I'm going to keep the routing rule and the rollout paused. If p99 stays <2.5s for 30m we'll keep routing until we have a corrected quant profile or fallback as default for long contexts. I'll also post a paging update to oncall.
alex (eng-oncall): handing to sophia for watch and postmortem coordination. I'll update incident channel and CS handoff. Owners: runtime=casey, sre=sophia, cs=mike.
sophia (eng-sre): acknowledged, taking handoff. next steps:
- collect traces and kv cache metrics (casey)
- generate heap and dequant timing traces (casey)
- customer impact list (mike)
- prepare rollback plan if routing doesn't stabilize (sophia)

jordan (prod): noting that streaming timeouts should be bumped in the next hour as a protective measure; I'll open a PR with the config change for review.
alex (eng-oncall): paging cleared for broad oncall rotation. if anything spikes, re-page with escalation. postmortem template will be created in ~2 hours. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
sophia (eng-sre): final note: no data loss, no error-rate spike; impact is latency-only for long-context streaming with the new quant profile. we'll aim to ship corrected quant table or rollback to int8-v1 within 24h depending on root cause.
